data.failure.yml:
- hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Expected acceptance failure
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: AUTOMATION_EXPECTED_FAILURE
data.pve-sync.yml:
---
- name: PVE 虚拟机与主机管理同步
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: 核对并同步 PVE 虚拟机台账
      ansible.builtin.command:
        argv: "{{ ['python3', playbook_dir + '/sync_pve_hosts.py', '--config', '/run/pve-sync/config.json'] + ([] if ansible_check_mode else ['--apply']) }}"
      check_mode: false
      register: sync_result
      changed_when: "not ansible_check_mode and 'DONE ' in sync_result.stdout"
    - name: 显示同步结果
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: sync_result.stdout_lines
data.stop.yml:
- hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Wait before writing isolated marker
      ansible.builtin.shell: sleep 20; echo STOP_FAILED > /tmp/automation-stop-marker
      changed_when: false
data.success.yml:
- hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Validate isolated execution
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that: 2 + 2 == 4
    - name: Report acceptance
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: AUTOMATION_REAL_EXECUTION_OK
data.wireguard-install.yml:
# opscenter-parameters: [{"name":"server_id","label":"目标主机","type":"host","default":"","required":true,"description":"选择要安装或核验WireGuard的主机","options":[]},{"name":"hub_id","label":"WireGuard Hub","type":"host","default":"c61ce536-a1ca-412b-a32b-956c309e1349","required":true,"description":"","options":[]},{"name":"interface","label":"接口名称","type":"text","default":"wg0","required":true,"description":"","options":[]},{"name":"pool","label":"自动分配地址池","type":"text","default":"10.66.66.0/24","required":true,"description":"","options":[]},{"name":"endpoint","label":"Hub Endpoint","type":"text","default":"182.92.223.237:51820","required":false,"description":"公网域名或IPv4:端口","options":[]}]
---
- name: 主机 WireGuard 安装与自动分配地址
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: 安装并核验 WireGuard 隧道
      ansible.builtin.command:
        argv: [python3, "{{ playbook_dir }}/install_wireguard.py", --config, /run/pve-sync/config.json]
        stdin: "{{ {'server_id': server_id, 'hub_id': hub_id, 'interface': interface | default('wg0'), 'pool': pool | default('10.66.66.0/24'), 'endpoint': endpoint | default(''), 'dry_run': ansible_check_mode} | to_json }}"
      check_mode: false
      register: wg_result
      changed_when: >-
        not ansible_check_mode and (wg_result.stdout.split(' ', 1)[1] | from_json).get('changed', false)
    - name: 显示地址及隧道验证结果
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: wg_result.stdout_lines

command: umask 0007; mkdir -p /state/gateway /state/engine /state/config /state/runbooks; export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/state/runbooks; find /state/runbooks -user 10001 -exec chmod g+rwX {} +; for f in /runbooks/*.yml /runbooks/*.py; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; n=${f##*/}; [ -e "/state/runbooks/$n" ] || cp "$f" "/state/runbooks/$n"; done; cd /state/runbooks; [ -d .git ] || git init -b main; git config core.sharedRepository group; git add -- '*.yml' '*.py'; if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then git -c user.name=OpsCenter -c user.email=automation@localhost commit -m 'Add PVE inventory sync runbook'; fi
